proof.text: Convert the finite-value constructibility hypothesis using isConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf_iff, pull it back along X.fromSpecResidueField x with IsConstructibleSheaf.upperStar, and convert back. Apply constructible_field_finite_separable_constant to this residue-field pullback, obtaining a finite-dimensional separable extension K and a finite module M with a trivialization e on Spec K.

Noetherian X is quasi-separated. Apply normalization_in_finite_residue_field_extension to K. Obtain integral nu:Y -> X, integral Y with integrally closed stalks, g:Spec K -> Y, the equality g followed by nu = the extension map followed by the residue-field inclusion, and generic image and residue-field isomorphism of g.

Reuse Core's private isIso_unit_constantSheaf_of_generic_residueFieldIso through import all. Its argument identifies g's image with the generic point. The source and generic stalks are fields, so their residue quotient maps are isomorphisms; the residue-field square and supplied residue-field isomorphism make g's stalk map an isomorphism. Thus Spec.map (Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo g) is an isomorphism whose composite with the canonical generic-stalk morphism equals g. Apply the normal constant generic unit theorem to that canonical morphism. The composition-unit equation transports this isomorphism along the source isomorphism; cancel the final isomorphism to obtain the unit for g.

Use the inverse-image composition isomorphism for g and nu, transport across the normalization factorization equality, and use the composition isomorphism for the field-extension map and the residue-field inclusion. Compose with e and the inverse of upperStarConstantSheafIso at M. This identifies g^*nu^*F with g^*M_Y. Package Y, nu, K, g, M, their integrality and finiteness, the unit isomorphism, and this trivialization. Retain the algebra structure hAlg, the finite-dimensional (hence Module.Finite) witness hfin, and the normalization square hcomp in the final existential, rather than discarding them.

title: Normalized generic data with a finite residue-field factorization
statement:
Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring, $F$ a constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf], and $x\in X$. There exist a scheme $Y$, an integral morphism $
u:Y	o X$ [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], a field $K$, a morphism $g:\operatorname{Spec}K	o Y$, and a finite $\Lambda$-module $M$ such that, writing $M_Y$ for the constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], the adjunction unit $M_Y	o g_*g^*M_Y$ is an isomorphism and $g^*
u^*F\cong g^*M_Y$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Moreover, there exists a $\kappa(x)$-algebra structure $a$ on $K$ making $K$ a finite-dimensional $\kappa(x)$-module [def-weil-residue-field], such that $\iota_x\circ\operatorname{Spec}(a)=
u\circ g$, where $\iota_x:\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(x)	o X$ is the canonical residue-field morphism.

theorem exists_constructible_module_normalized_generic_data_with_factorization
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (hF : Scheme.IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf F) (x : X) :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (ν : Y ⟶ X), IsIntegralHom ν ∧
      ∃ (K : Type u) (_ : Field K) (g : Spec (.of K) ⟶ Y)
        (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ), Finite M ∧
        IsIso ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g).unit.app
          ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)) ∧
        Nonempty
          ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g).obj
            ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) ν).obj F) ≅
           (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g).obj
            ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)) ∧
        ∃ a : Algebra (X.residueField x) K,
          @Module.Finite (X.residueField x) K _ _ a.toModule ∧
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (@algebraMap (X.residueField x) K _ _ a)) ≫
            X.fromSpecResidueField x = g ≫ ν
